checks.detail: abstract section should be present.
introduction section should be present.
methods section should be present.
results section should be present.
discussion section should be present.
limitations section should be present.

references section should be present.
Paper should disclose survey weights and strata/PSU or complex survey limitations.
Paper should report sample construction and cohort counts.
Paper should discuss missingness or complete-case handling.
Paper should include at least three source URLs.
No obvious causal overclaim terms found.
Paper should explicitly bound observational/cross-sectional inference.
No obvious diagnostic overclaim terms found.
Companion evidence JSON should be readable.
Generated paper-run papers should start with a local-review safety header covering survey method, weight domain, causal status, actionability, and human review.
Evidence should include row counts or eligible cohort evidence.
Evidence should include limitations or survey-design notes.
Linear-regression evidence should be reported with mean-difference/coefficient language.
Papers using subsample-specific weights must disclose the subsample analytic population and weight-domain rationale.
Evidence for subsample-specific weights should include rationale and eligibility notes.
Paper should include the evidence effect estimate near 0.8369756383117846.
Paper should include evidence CI bounds near 0.7283388357290876 to 0.9456124408944815.
Paper should include evidence p-value near 1.6066045206646713e-51.
Paper should disclose covariate adjustment groups present in evidence JSON.
